evidence: Translucent teal pleated HEPA filter marked WASHABLE HEPA FILTER mounted above a grey cylindrical casing with dyson branding.
Purple radial cyclone assembly positioned directly beneath the grey motor housing.
missing_evidence: The lower dustbin, bin compression mechanism, handle, power controls, and rear display are out of frame below.
contradictions: The in-line cylindrical filter and motor housing positioned coaxially above the cyclones contradict the perpendicular bin layout of the V8, the wheeled canister of the Big Ball, and the dual-roller tank structure of the WashG1.
decision.retake: A photo showing the complete machine body including the dustbin, handle, and rear display.

candidate_checks.evidence: The coaxial in-line arrangement of the HEPA filter and motor housing above the cyclones contradicts the perpendicular bin and top pre-filter layout of the V8.
The handheld in-line stick vacuum body contradicts the separate wheeled spherical canister architecture of the Big Ball.
The radial cyclone assembly and upper cylindrical filter contradict the dedicated wet-cleaning dual-roller and clean/dirty water tank architecture of the WashG1.
Distinguishing features such as the separate on/off push button, narrower body diameter, and bin assembly are out of frame.
The in-line cyclone and filter layout is consistent, but distinguishing features including the handle trigger, dustbin, and rear display are out of frame.
The upper in-line cylindrical filter and cyclone body are consistent, but distinguishing features such as the CleanCompaktor mechanism and handle controls are out of frame.

o1.refinement_reason: Inspect the full dustbin mechanism, handle controls, and rear display to distinguish between the in-line Dyson cordless models.
